scope: HostOwnedReset step 1 (spike S-A + Quick Checklist markup). Debug Swift test harness (BenchmarkTests, one window), system WKWebView on macOS 26 (Darwin 25.6). Single runs; open times vary run to run (0.6-2.8 s at 1k).

method.bench: HITSLOP_BENCH=1 HITSLOP_BENCH_ROWS=1000,5000 HITSLOP_BENCH_WINDOWS=1 [HITSLOP_BENCH_LABEL=...] bun run bench:windows
method.acceptance_p95: 100 back-to-back checkbox writes; each waits for the host reply and snapshot update
method.idle_acceptance_p95: 40 checkbox writes, each started 100 ms after the previous one (like a real click)
method.frame_after_edit: time from acceptance until the main thread is free (JS flush + WebKit layout)
method.click_split: click -> DOM mutation (js), forced layout, remainder; same probe in scripts/bench-webkit.ts (Playwright WebKit) and scripts/bench-wkwebview.swift (plain system WKWebView)

5000.result: did not reach ready within 15 s

autosave_pushed_to_5s_1000.note: autosave is not the main cost

sdk_fanout_1000.note: root cause of the 1k edit latency

fixes: SDK: bindings subscribe to their own path; a publication notifies only touched paths (full refresh on resync/barrier/preview)
Checklist: rows render as text and promote to a bound textarea on focus/click (caret from caretRangeFromPoint)
Checklist: native checkbox, one shared bits-ui menu (customAnchor), CSS grid auto-grow instead of per-row ResizeObserver, no animate:flip, content-visibility on rows, contain: strict on the scroller

5000.checkbox_p95_le_100ms: acceptance passes (12 ms idle); WebKit layout afterwards ~170 ms fails. Accepted by the maintainer: 1k is the product target.

webkit_layout_scaling.conclusion: Superlinear layout in the macOS system WebKit build; the same page in newer WebKit (Playwright build 2359) lays out in 6 ms.
